questions.stem: A 22-year-old man with schizophrenia presents to the emergency with the acute onset of a fixed upward gaze bilaterally. He had his drug dose increased 2 days prior. The patient says that angels are forcing him to look up to heaven and avoid looking down at hell. His MSE is significant for an anxious mood, flat affect, and the above delusions. His physical examination demonstrates a continued, upward gaze of his eyes bilaterally. What is the most likely diagnosis?
